newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 245 mln rupees investment bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 245 mln rupees investment bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned on Friday three-year and 10-year maturity federal investment bonds worth 245 million rupees.
It accepted bids worth 50 million rupees at par for the three-year maturity bonds and worth 195 million rupees at par for the 10-year bonds, a bank statement said. The settlement is set for Monday.
In the previous auction on May 3, the bank accepted bids worth 50 million rupees at par for three-year maturity bonds and one million rupees at par for 10-year maturity bonds.
